dialect.detail: Compuware ISPW training program targeting IBM-370 mainframe; uses RECORDING MODE IS F, LABEL RECORDS OMITTED, BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS, and GOBACK — all typical IBM mainframe COBOL conventions

purpose.domain_detail: Compuware ISPW training suite — demonstrates calling a subroutine (TSUBR06) and using copybooks (TCPYA06, TCPYB06) to read input and write formatted output
purpose.summary: A Compuware ISPW training program that opens an output file, calls subroutine TSUBR06 to read records from an input file, formats the retrieved text into a report with decorative star lines and body lines, and writes the result to OUTFILE. It demonstrates CALL with a linkage area, COPY members, and a PERFORM THRU loop.

notable_features: COPY TCPYA06 and COPY TCPYB06 for header and link area
PERFORM THRU with EXIT paragraph (GET-MESSAGE THRU GET-MESSAGE-X)
LABEL RECORDS OMITTED / BLOCK CONTAINS 0 RECORDS
ACTION-FLAG used to control subroutine behavior (R=read, C=close)
verdict.notes: Program is clearly a Compuware ISPW training artifact dated 1996. The COPY members TCPYA06 and TCPYB06 are not shown, so data definitions for PASS-ME-AROUND, INFILE-EOF, TEXT-PORTION, MESSANGER, STAR-LINE-1, FLASH-LINE, BODY-LINE, BODY-TEXT, MESSAGE-LINE are inferred from context. No SQL or CICS. Max line length 62 confirms fixed format with no lines exceeding column 72.
